_why: A security control with no caller is not a control. Three shipped that way in one week (see scripts/ci/check-security-boundary-wired.mjs). This registry names the boundaries whose WIRING is checked mechanically, not just whose behaviour is unit-tested. Add an entry when a slice introduces a function or parameter whose whole purpose is to refuse something.

boundaries.why: the DNS-rebinding refusal. Shipped in #487 with zero callers, so a hostname that looks public and resolves to 127.0.0.1 or 169.254.169.254 was fetched normally for a full day.

the second parameter carries the registrar host set. Both call sites pass one argument, so the set is always the empty default and a document served by a legitimate registrar is still refused. A caller count cannot see this: the function IS called.
shipped in #476 with zero production callers, so every flag added afterwards was OFF on staging and any staging proof that depended on one would have come back empty.
